description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Temporal Manipulation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.
